subject: Identity capability package and SCIM samples for Northwood RFP
messages:
From: Emily Turner <emily.turner@northwood.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@northwood.com
Date: Sun, 5 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Northwood RFP — identity & provisioning clarifications

Irene,

Thanks for the RFP submission earlier this week. We're combing through vendor responses and have a few follow-ups specifically on SSO/SCIM and admin controls before we move to the demo stage. Can you confirm the following items?

1) Do you support both SAML 2.0 and OIDC for SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows? Any known limitations (IdP metadata size, specific attributes required)?
2) Can you provide sample SCIM v2 payloads for user create/update/delete and an example of a bulk sync flow for >10k users?
3) We need a clear RBAC matrix showing admin and support roles, what actions they can perform (user management, key rotation, view logs, tenant-level config).
4) For our compliance team: where are audit logs retained, do they include per-token model and route details, and can logs be exported to our SIEM?

If possible, please send sample artifacts and an estimated timeline for an evidence package we can attach to our procurement recommendation.

Best,
Emily Turner
Senior IT Procurement Manager
Northwood Financial
[Phone: +1-617-555-0182]

From: irene.choi@redwood.ai
To: Emily Turner <emily.turner@northwood.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northwood RFP — identity & provisioning clarifications

Emily —

Thanks for the concise list. I've put together a focused identity capability package and attached sample artifacts. High level answers up front:

- SSO: Redwood supports both SAML 2.0 and OIDC (RP and IdP initiation). There are no vendor-imposed metadata size limits on our side; very large metadata is primarily an IdP concern and we recommend splitting long certificate chains if necessary. We can accept email/name and custom attributes via SAML assertions or OIDC claims.

- SCIM: We support SCIM v2 for user and group provisioning, incremental delta sync, and an option for bulk import via compressed newline-delimited JSON. For directories >10k accounts, we recommend our paged delta sync combined with pre-warming and a one-time bulk import.

- RBAC: Attached is an admin matrix mapping roles (Org Admin, Security Admin, Support Engineer, Billing Admin, Read-Only Auditor) to actions. We support delegation and scoped admin roles per-tenant.

- Audit logs: Auth and provisioning events, per-request model/route identifiers, token usage, and admin changes are logged. Logs are retained by default for 365 days for Dedicated/Private plans and can be exported to your S3/Syslog/Splunk instance; retention/forwarding is configurable.

Attached: Redwood_SCIM_sample_payloads.json (sample create/update/delete and bulk format), RBAC_Admin_Matrix_v3.xlsx (action-to-role mapping and examples), SSO_OIDC_flow_diagram.pdf (flow diagram + IdP metadata guidance).

Next steps:
- If you want a hands-on test tenant with SCIM enabled we can provision a trial tenant; tell me the desired subdomain and whether you want SCIM to push members into a single default org or into mapped groups.
- I can schedule a 45-min technical walkthrough with our integration engineer (Ben) and implementation lead (Marissa) — suggested times Wed/Thu this week.

If you need any of the sample artifacts in a different format (CSV RBAC, ndjson for bulk import), let us know and we'll regenerate.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_SCIM_sample_payloads.json (application/json)]
[Attachment: RBAC_Admin_Matrix_v3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: SSO_OIDC_flow_diagram.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Emily Turner <emily.turner@northwood.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@northwood.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northwood RFP — identity & provisioning clarifications

Irene —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the artifacts — they look useful. A couple of follow-ups after a quick review:

• For SCIM bulk imports: can you confirm whether you support idempotent upserts when re-ingesting a bulk NDJSON file (we want to avoid duplicate accounts if the job is retried).
• For RBAC: our security team requires a sample evidence extract showing a change event (user promotion to Org Admin) with the associated audit log entry. Can you export a redacted example?
• Test tenant: yes please — we would like scim-test.northwood.nw as the subdomain and have SCIM push users into a mapped group structure (Northwood/Employee / Northwood/Contractor).

If you can get the test tenant provisioned and a short 30-min tech call scheduled, we can move to a procurement recommendation by next Tuesday.

Best,
Emily

From: irene.choi@redwood.ai
To: Emily Turner <emily.turner@northwood.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northwood RFP — identity & provisioning clarifications

Emily —

All good — answers inline below and next steps at the end.

• SCIM bulk idempotency: yes. Our bulk import accepts a client-supplied externalId and will perform idempotent upserts. We include an idempotency-key header to make retries safe; the sample payload in the attachment shows externalId present on each user object.

• Audit evidence: attached is a redacted audit extract (event id and timestamp preserved, user emails replaced with redacted placeholders) showing a role change from Contributor to Org Admin and the corresponding admin session id and IP.

• Test tenant: provisioned. Details below.

--- Provisioned tenant details ---
Tenant: scim-test.northwood.nw
Admin console URL: https://scim-test.northwood.nw/console
SCIM endpoint: https://scim-test.northwood.nw/scim/v2/Users
Client ID / Secret: (sent via separate secure channel)
Initial mapping: incoming SCIM group "/Northwood/Employee" -> Redwood group "Employees"; "/Northwood/Contractor" -> "Contractors".

I've also scheduled a 30-min integration call for Thu 09/09 at 10:00 AM ET with Ben and Marissa; invitation will follow via calendar.

Attachments added to the package in Drive: Audit_RoleChange_Redacted.csv, updated RBAC matrix (rows flagged for required MFA), and an NDJSON bulk example keyed by externalId. Links in the Drive share above.

Let us know if you want the client secret delivered to an alternative vault or if you'd like us to create a temporary S3 import bucket for the nb-import job.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
